Header.title: J-FROZZ Engineering Services and Electro-Mechanical Trading
Header.paragraph: Your trusted partner in Engineering and Supply in the fields of Electro-Mechanical and Civil Engineering.

About.paragraph: J-Frozz Engineering Services and Electro-Mechanical Trading is an engineering and trading firm specializing in electro-mechanical and civil engineering solutions. Through our Engineering Services, we provide end-to-end design, installation, and maintenance of HVAC, fire protection, CCTV, solar, plumbing, and mechanical systems. Complementing this, our Electro-Mechanical Trading division supplies high-quality tools, equipment, and components to support contractors, developers, and industries.
About.mission: Our Mission is to provide innovative, reliable, and cost-effective electro-mechanical and civil engineering solutions, alongside high-quality products and materials, to support the success of infrastructure and industrial projects. We are committed to delivering excellence in service and supply, driven by expertise, integrity, and customer satisfaction.
About.vison: Our Vision is to be a trusted and leading partner in the engineering and construction industry — known for seamlessly integrating technical services and product distribution that power progress, build sustainable communities, and shape the future of modern infrastructure at an affordable cost

Services.name: Design, Supply, and Installation of HVAC Systems
Services.text: Customized air conditioning solutions for residential, commercial, and industrial applications, including split-type, VRF, and PACU systems.

Services.name: Air Conditioning Repair, Cleaning and Preventive Maintenance
Services.text: Regular maintenance and troubleshooting services to extend equipment lifespan and ensure reliable system performance.

Services.name: Design, Supply, and Installation of Fire Protection and FDAS
Services.text: Complete setup of fire suppression systems and fire detection and alarm systems, including piping, sensors, alarms and compliance documentation.

Services.name: Design, Supply, and Installation of CCTV System
Services.text: Provision and deployment of surveillance systems with professional installation, cabling, and system configuration.

Services.name: Solar Power System Installation
Services.text: End-to-end setup of solar energy systems for homes, business, and agricultrual use - including solar panels, inverters, and battery integration.

Services.name: Plumbing Works with Design, Installation, and Sign & Seal
Services.text: Full-service plumbing projects, from system design to on-site installation, with sign and seal by licensed engineers.

Services.name: Design and Sign & Seal of Mechanical plans

Services.text: Through our trading arm, we provide high-quality tools, equipment, and components for mechanical, electrical, and HVAC applications.
